messages:
tara: Quick sync — proposed 'policy runway' initiative to standardize multi-region routing + isolation. Goal: a pilot that lets Sales onboard 1–2 enterprise customers with residency + predictable latency. Thoughts?
simon: love the name. can you sketch the minimal scope for a pilot?
tara: minimal = 3 pieces: 1) routing policy DSL (region, affinity, fallback), 2) lightweight tenant slices (soft isolation + quotas), 3) rollout/playbook (canary + automated fallback).
matt: ops concern: need clear SLOs and observable fallbacks. otherwise we'll get pages.
eli: +1. propose SLOs: p99 latency < 450ms for local-region traffic, error rate < 0.5% across model calls, and fallback < 200ms added tail.
anne: data residency ask from legal: pilot must support region tagging at request level and audit logs exported to customer KMS. that's non-negotiable for some prospects.
tom-sales: customer A (healthcare) is asking for a timeline — they'd be willing to pilot in Q4 if we can show residency + contract terms.
simon: tradeoffs: fully isolated hardware in pilot is expensive. can we do logical isolation with strong network controls and tenant quotas?
tara: yes, pilot will be logical slices w/ strict egress controls and per-tenant network policies. We’ll define 'isolation tiers' in spec.
matt: rollout/playbook needs automatic fallback to a global lane if regional capacity exhausted. Who owns fallback SLAs?
eli: eng-runtime will own behavioral fallback (model variant routing). SRE owns region health gating and automated evacuations.
aram: ops-bot: Deployment window scheduled: 2026-11-03 02:00 UTC -> notify channels when canary reaches > 95% success rate. :robot_face:
simon: can we make a list of launch criteria? I'll draft and we can sign off.
tara: draft acceptance criteria (short):
- Tech: routing DSL v0 supports region, affinity, fallback, and per-tenant quotas (api + infra config).
- Security/compliance: per-request region tag + audit export to KMS-enabled storage.
- Observability: per-tenant p50/p95/p99 latency + fallback counts + rollout traces in Console.
- Reliability: canary flow + automated rollback if canary error rate > 1% or p99 worsens by > 30%.
- Business: 2 pilot customers onboarded, billing meter for reserved capacity.

eli: add test requirement: replay harness for synthetic traffic that includes cold-cache long-tail tokens.
anne: legal wants retention window for audit logs configurable per-customer. add to acceptance.
tom-sales: timeline question again — what's the expected duration of pilot?
tara: target 8–10 week pilot window after internal dogfood. So Q4 pilot feasible if eng slates it for Nov rollout.
simon: risks: cross-region data egress costs and network throttling. mitigation: clear pricing annex + capacity caps per-tenant.
matt: also config guardrails to prevent accidental global fallback during maintenance. prefer an intentional override toggle.
tara: agreed. I'll add an 'emergency-evacuate' flag that requires two-owner approval.
simon: last ask — migration path: customers should be able to opt from logical slices -> dedicated racks. spec needs runbook and costs.
tara: noted. we'll include migration checklist and a rough price delta estimate for Dedicated.
eli: ok, action items:
- simon: draft launch criteria doc and migration checklist (ETA 3 days)
- matt: design fallback SLOs + canary rollback hooks (ETA 1 week)
- anne: residency + retention config wording for legal (ETA 4 days)
- tom-sales: confirm 2 pilot customers and contractual asks (ETA 1 week)
- tara: consolidate into a single PRD and schedule sync (ETA 5 days)

tom-sales: I'll ping customer A today and try to lock them in. :crossed_fingers:
simon: thanks — add me to any customer calls. :eyes: 
tara: thanks all. I'll post the PRD link when ready and add a short checklist for eng signoff. :shipit:
ops-bot: Note: #product will be notified when PRD link is posted.
